note: Set A is significantly more comprehensive, capturing the full revision history, drawing scales, and project client information which Set B completely omits. While both sets accurately extract the elevation data (Grade Level and Finished Floor) and Lot Number, Set B fails to extract the revision table and section scales, which are critical engineering metadata present in the text layer. Set A contains some redundancy in how it labels elevation attributes, but this is preferable to the missing data in Set B.
